El metdala3 theory!

In this challenge, we will be doing "Abandoned but Not Forgotten." The idea here is to use creative writing and technology to make stories about space tools that are left behind on the Moon and Mars.
summary: we provided a project of art, we managed to mix Egyptian culture with technology, by making a Website, this website main purpose is to educate people about the some tools that is left throughout the space trips to the moon. this tools were useful for the astronauts in many ways. A video was made about the story of NASA's abundant equipments that were left on the Moon. An egyptian celebrity "Tamer Elgayar" is the astronaut that shows us in the video these equipments in a short video from.
details: java script, HTML, CSS, those are the key language we used to make our website, that aims towards making people know better about the tools that are used in the space trips from apollo 11 to apollo 17 we provided an educational video that is showing the Egyptian celebrity as an astronaut in the space trip and showing the tools and it's usage. .
